classification: prospective CPU mechanism pilot; not formal or paper-facing evidence

analysis.primary_unit: mean over the 64 registered seeds within each of 324 cells
analysis.normalized_regret: (observable true score - oracle true score)/(abs(oracle true score)+contraction*state_signal*eta_max+resource_price*q_max)

mandatory_gates.G1: 324 cells, 64 unique seeds, and 20736 endpoints are present
mandatory_gates.G2: all statistics and scores are finite and noise estimates are nonnegative
mandatory_gates.G5: observable joint action improves over the fixed (q,eta) action in at least 60% of cells
mandatory_gates.G6: clairvoyant joint action strictly improves over both q-only and eta-only actions in at least 30% of cells
mandatory_gates.G7: observable joint action beats the better one-dimensional ablation in at least 50% of cells
mandatory_gates.G8: median selected q is nonincreasing in rho on at least 90% of matched grid paths
mandatory_gates.G9: median selected eta is nondecreasing in state signal on at least 90% of matched grid paths
mandatory_gates.G10: every endpoint obeys both fully charged budgets
mandatory_gates.G11: runner has no access to evaluated noise when selecting an action
